name: How to Tackle the Aftermath of an Apartment Fire

step.name: Step 1
step.text: An apartment fire can be incredibly disruptive, not just to your unit but potentially to your neighbors as well. The aftermath requires a structured approach to ensure safety and effective restoration. First, ensure your safety and the safety of any co-residents. Evacuate immediately and let the fire department do their job. Don't re-enter your apartment until fire officials have declared it safe – there might be hidden dangers like structural weakness, toxic air, or active hot spots. Next, you need to contact your landlord or property management right away. They'll need to know about the damage and can help coordinate with insurance and restoration efforts for the building. After that, notify your renter's insurance company to start your claim; they’ll guide you on next steps for personal belongings and temporary housing. For the actual cleanup of smoke, soot, and any water damage from extinguishing the fire, it's really best to call in professionals.
